EditTextPreference.app:title: My name
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: What the others see in their crew list, e.g. Skipper. Leave empty to use the name of this phone. Up to 32 bytes; applies immediately.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Channel name
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: Shown large at the top of the main screen: the boat or the crew, e.g. ARABELLA. Up to 24 characters; empty shows the app name.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Full duplex
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOn: The big button toggles the mic; everyone is heard at once. Best with a headset.
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOff: Hold the big button to talk; others are muted while you hold it.

Preference.app:summary: Press once: mic on. Press again: mic off. Holding a headset button talks for as long as you hold it. A volume key works the same, press for press.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Voice keys the mic
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: With a Bluetooth headset: just speak. The mic keys itself when you talk and un-keys 1.5 s after you stop; mute the headset to be sure you are off air. For headsets whose button does not reach the app. With the phone at your ear it is always on, on any output but the loudspeaker.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Talk key tones
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: One tone in the ear when a talk key keys the mic, two when it un-keys it. Off: the buzz on the phone only.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Headset button hangs up
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Only if a Bluetooth headset's button does nothing here: some headsets send a hang-up instead of a media key. This registers the channel with the phone as a call while such a headset is in use, so the hang-up becomes the talk key. It shows on car kits as a call, and a phone call puts the channel on hold.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Keep screen on
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: While on the channel. Turn off when a headset or the volume keys do the talking.
Forward what this phone hears to its other links, so phones out of each other's range still connect through it. Leave on.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Opus compression
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: About a tenth of the bandwidth of raw audio. Falls back to raw by itself if this phone cannot encode Opus. Applies the next time the mic is keyed.

PreferenceCategory.app:title: WLAN — takes effect on the next Connect

EditTextPreference.app:title: Multicast group
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: An IPv4 multicast address, 224.0.0.0 to 239.255.255.255. Every phone on the crew must use the same one.

EditTextPreference.app:title: UDP port
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: 1024 to 65535, the same on every phone.

PreferenceCategory.app:title: Wi‑Fi Aware — takes effect on the next Connect

EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: 8 to 63 plain ASCII characters. Phones only link up when it matches, so it doubles as the crew name.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Hop limit
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: How many relays a packet may cross, 1 to 16. Also caps what this phone forwards for others. Applies immediately.
